_comment: Security audit settings. Every entry here is an explicit, reviewed exception or expectation: keep a reason on each. Do not add entries to make the audit pass without fixing the cause.

publicKeys.name: vendor licence / update / preset-pack verification key (P-256, public half only)

secretAllow.reason: upstream asio (Boost licence) SSL example certificates and keys for its demo programs; not ours, never shipped, never used by any build target

signatureVerifiers.title: desktop update manifest is verified (ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256) with the pinned vendor key
licence keys are verified with the pinned vendor key
console (C++) verifies licences with the pinned vendor key
Android verifies signed manifests (SHA256withECDSA) with the pinned key
Android self-update: signed manifest + sha256 of the APK before PackageInstaller
console updater verifies update.json (ECDSA P-256, pinned kVendorJwk) and the sha256 of the download
Windows updater tool verifies the manifest signature (fails closed without the key)
npm installer verifies the signed manifest with the pinned key

signers.title: the vendor private key lives outside the repository (~/.audio-mixer-vendor or AUDIO_MIXER_VENDOR_DIR)
update.json is signed with the key from the vendor folder

vendored.name: Tailwind CSS Play CDN build 3.4.16 (served locally to the staff / customer pages)

networkFiles._comment: extra files to treat as network servers even when the generic detection misses them
